responsibility: Implements the tree-identifier layer of GCC’s spelling suggestion support. It adapts the generic edit-distance machinery to IDENTIFIER_NODE values by computing distances from identifier spellings and by scanning candidate vectors of tree identifiers to choose the closest meaningful match, supplying frontend and semantic diagnostics with near-match suggestions for misspelled identifiers rather than arbitrary strings.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the spellcheck-tree pair: it performs identifier-node edit-distance computation and closest-candidate selection over vectors of tree identifiers, whereas spellcheck-tree.h declares those routines and the edit_distance_traits<tree> specialization used by the generic spellcheck layer.
